features: Eagle Eye Cloud Managed Video Recorder (CMVR): stores video locally and acts as a gateway to the Eagle Eye cloud
Video encrypted in transit and at rest
Datasheet: Bridges and CMVRs support ONVIF Profile S IP cameras
Max cameras: up to 35 IP cameras @4MP (typical)
LPR support: Yes (2023 datasheet: up to 2 LPR cameras)
Storage capacity: 24 TB (30 days for 35 cameras @ 4MP) per 2025 datasheet; 2023 datasheet states 10 TB
Conflict: video output stated as VGA (1), HDMI (1), DP (1) in the 2023 datasheet and HDMI (1), VGA (1) in the 2025 datasheet; value omitted
Conflict: dimensions stated as 427 x 251 x 45 mm in the 2023 datasheet and 485 x 254 x 45 mm in the 2025 datasheet; value omitted
Conflict: maximum power consumption stated as 50 W in the 2023 datasheet and 150 W in the 2025 datasheet; value omitted
